heading: Comments
readOnly: You can read this discussion. Commenting is unavailable with your current access.
archived: This task is archived. Existing discussion is read-only.
otherPending: Another comment is pending or unconfirmed. Open its discussion to resolve it.

problem.nul: Remove the unsupported NUL character before posting.

recovery.unknown: A comment is unconfirmed. Its original text is retained.
recovery.pending: A comment is still being posted. Its original text is retained.
recovery.draft: An unsent comment draft is kept on this page.

activity.heading: Activity
activity.currentNames: Activity uses current member names. Comment authors use their name recorded when posted.
